modules.reason: Existing scripts declare they were prepared from lesson titles and notes, without completed original-image review.
Existing scripts explicitly record direct image visual review as pending.
Existing scripts explicitly record image-by-image visual review not independently completed.
Scripts claim original-WebP visual review; verify correspondence against slides and user feedback before replacing.

quality_gate.primary_source: Read each original numbered WebP in public/course-visuals/aif-course/module-NN, not only lesson-map text.
required_per_scene: Confirm exact slide number and visible title
Describe on-screen labels, arrows, diagrams, charts, data or examples in meaningful visual order
Define beginner terminology at first use
Explain how the on-screen mechanism works and why choices differ
Limit off-screen additions to brief directly relevant teaching examples
Use natural, varied teaching speech; no repeated generic boilerplate
Verify every specific AWS service and claim actually belongs to the pictured slide
block_when: Images have not been individually inspected
Generic unrelated paragraphs recur across scenes
Script mentions visuals or numerical values not verified on image
Scene sequence/slide IDs do not match originals
required_before_publication: New approved script_revision for each part
Render MP4, VTT, SRT, transcript and manifest from same revised script
Check caption/audio synchronization and chapter/slide sequence
Verify MP4 and manifest objects in Cloudflare R2 before site availability
Retain previous published version until replacement is validated

execution: This queue is a worklist, not a renderer trigger. Do not rerun current scripts unchanged. After image-by-image review and script rewrite, update narration manifests and workflow expected revision together; their existing push triggers then queue rendering.
